title: SHA-224 used to generate obfuscated host ID — deprecated in stricter security policies
detail: The generate_hostid function (line 857-871) hashes project_id+host using hashlib.sha224 to produce an opaque identifier returned in API responses. SHA-224 is a truncated variant of SHA-256 and is not cryptographically broken; however, NIST SP 800-131Ar2 and some organisational policies disallow SHA-224 for new constructions in favour of SHA-256 or higher. In the same file, get_sha256_str (line 603) already provides a SHA-256 helper that could replace this usage without changing the function's semantics. This is not a password or key-derivation hash — it serves solely as an obfuscation identifier for API consumers.
